rate_gates.why: A college rate is computed over the games he appears in, which can miss a game he played quietly. That error was measured in the NFL, where the true figure is known: median 0.2 points, 90th percentile 3.8. It is largest at short reception lines, so those carry no rate, and a market that was never measured carries none either.

single_day_rule: This board is 2026-09-26 only. Priced rows for another day are not shown here and neither are parlays that would cross days — a card dated one day and half-filled with the next is two facts under one label. Minimum 5, maximum 25; a day with no games is an empty board, and that is correct.
coverage: 2,698 priced football rows for 2026-09-26 across 53 board games; 25 shown.
calibration_warning: This card changed how it rates: it now reads this season first and pulls thin records toward the average; before the change, when it said 70-80%, those plays hit 33.3% (12 graded). That earlier record is kept apart and is not counted in the figures below. There are not enough graded College Football plays yet to say whether these confidence numbers hold up — 23 so far, and no band has reached 20. Treat every one as unproven.
board_rule: Sorted by the player's own record at that exact line, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses. Rows with no record sit below every row that has one.
no_model_note: 🔴 No row on this board carries a Gizmo's confidence rating and none ever will on today's evidence. Four pre-registered football models were tested and every one lost to a player's own season average. What is shown is his OWN RECORD and the market's price — both labelled.
college_note: College records are counted over the games a player appears in. College box scores list him only when he did something, so a game he played quietly can be missing — which nudges an over slightly high. That gap was measured against the NFL, where the true figure is known: a median of 0.2 percentage points and 3.8 at the 90th percentile. Short reception lines, where the gap is biggest, carry no record at all.
